_comment: Human-defined target feature framework for the Headcount Planning category (category_id=34 in production), approved by Brian 2026-08-24 after reviewing the raw origination scan output. scripts/remap_queue_to_framework.py must not add, remove, or rename any bucket; it only decides which pending feature_review_queue proposals map to which bucket (or to none). Each bucket's 'name' is the exact canonical feature name to write back to the queue item's payload.feature.name — do not let the model paraphrase it. 'hint' is matching guidance only (disambiguation for a human/LLM reviewer), not part of the stored feature name or definition. Roster note: this category currently mixes real headcount-planning platforms (Doublefin, Orgvue, Teamohana, Knoetic, ChartHop) with pure compensation-benchmarking data sources (Pave, Culpepper, Radford) — a future idea (logged separately, not acted on here) would split the benchmarking-only vendors into a new 'Headcount Benchmarking' section under Resources; for now all 8 tools stay in this one category's framework.

buckets.name: Cash compensation
buckets.hint: Benchmark/market data on base salary, bonus, and other cash pay by role/level/market.

buckets.name: Equity compensation
buckets.hint: Benchmark/market data on equity grants (options, RSUs, refresh guidelines) by role/level/market.

buckets.name: Custom peer groups
buckets.hint: Building a custom comparison set of peer companies for benchmarking, rather than relying only on a vendor's standard survey cuts.

buckets.name: Salary and promotion increase rates
buckets.hint: Benchmark data on merit increase percentages, promotion increase guidelines, and market movement rates.

buckets.name: Turnover/attrition rates
buckets.hint: Benchmark data on employee turnover/attrition rates by role, level, or industry — a data point, distinct from any internal analytics capability.

buckets.name: Job architecture
buckets.hint: Defining/structuring the overall job framework — families, tracks, levels — as a system, distinct from matching one job to that structure below.

buckets.name: Job leveling and matching
buckets.hint: Mapping a specific internal role/title to a level or to survey-matched benchmark job codes.

buckets.name: Requisition & hiring pipeline tracking
buckets.hint: Tracking open requisitions and where each hire stands in the pipeline — the ATS/recruiting-adjacent tracking capability.

buckets.name: Headcount plan building
buckets.hint: Building/authoring the headcount plan itself (target roles, timing, owners) — the planning workspace, distinct from the approval-routing workflow below.

buckets.name: Headcount request & approval routing
buckets.hint: The workflow for requesting a new headcount and routing it through approvers — distinct from building the plan itself.

buckets.name: Backfill requisition tracking
buckets.hint: Tracking/managing requisitions specifically opened to backfill a departed employee, as distinct from net-new headcount requests.

buckets.name: Scenario planning and org redesign modeling
buckets.hint: Modeling multiple what-if headcount/org scenarios or redesigning the org structure — a planning/simulation capability, distinct from viewing the current or planned org chart (bucket 21).

buckets.name: Compensation cycle worksheets
buckets.hint: Manager/HRBP worksheets used to run an annual or ad hoc comp review cycle (merit, bonus, equity refresh).

buckets.name: Pay risk & outlier flagging
buckets.hint: Automated flagging of pay equity risk, compa-ratio outliers, or other compensation anomalies.

buckets.name: Candidate offer letter generation
buckets.hint: Generating/drafting candidate offer letters, typically informed by benchmark/leveling data.

buckets.name: Headcount budget & cost tracking
buckets.hint: Tracking headcount cost against budget — actuals vs. plan for people cost specifically.

buckets.name: Multi-currency compensation planning
buckets.hint: Planning/budgeting compensation across multiple currencies for a global workforce.

buckets.name: Real-time/predictive headcount forecasting
buckets.hint: Live or predictive projection of future headcount numbers/cost, distinct from broader predictive workforce analytics below (which covers non-headcount-specific workforce metrics too).

buckets.name: Predictive workforce analytics
buckets.hint: Broader predictive/ML-driven workforce analytics (e.g. attrition risk, hiring likelihood) beyond pure headcount-number forecasting.

buckets.name: Custom workforce dashboards & reports
buckets.hint: Building custom dashboards/reports over workforce data — a general reporting/BI capability.

buckets.name: Org chart (current + planned roles)
buckets.hint: Visualizing the org chart, including both current and planned/future roles — a visualization, distinct from the scenario-modeling capability in bucket 12.

buckets.name: Historical headcount reporting
buckets.hint: Reporting on headcount trends/history over time.

buckets.name: Span of control & management layer analysis
buckets.hint: Analyzing manager-to-report ratios and management layers/org depth — includes benchmarking span of control against peer organizations as a dimension of this same feature, not a separate bucket.

buckets.name: HRIS/ATS/FP&A integrations
buckets.hint: Pre-built integrations syncing data with HRIS, ATS, or FP&A systems.

buckets.name: Open API
buckets.hint: A general-purpose, documented API for programmatic access to the platform's data/functions.

buckets.name: Spreadsheet import/export
buckets.hint: Importing data from or exporting data to spreadsheet files (Excel/CSV/Google Sheets).

buckets.name: Sandbox environment
buckets.hint: A test/sandbox environment for trying changes or building integrations without touching production data.

buckets.name: Role-based access control
buckets.hint: Granular user roles and permissions within the platform (who can see/do what).

buckets.name: Change history / audit trail
buckets.hint: A log/trail of changes made in the platform for audit/compliance purposes.

buckets.name: Workforce Q&A analyst
buckets.hint: A conversational/agentic AI assistant that answers workforce/headcount questions — the ONE bucket in this group where the underlying capability is expected to be AI-driven; the stored feature NAME still must not contain the word "AI" per docs/FEATURE_TAXONOMY.md §3 naming rules (ai_enabled on the link carries that signal instead).

buckets.name: Workforce data quality detection
buckets.hint: Automated detection of data-quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistencies) in workforce data.

buckets.name: Policy drafting and compliance analyst
buckets.hint: AI or workflow assistance drafting HR/compensation policy language or checking compliance — the stored feature NAME still must not contain the word "AI" per docs/FEATURE_TAXONOMY.md §3.
